_about: Seed glossary from the real-text test of 2026-11-15. The live glossary belongs in the private data repository, not here. terms = words the dictionary lacks or splits wrongly; senses = a first meaning to show before the dictionary's; readings = context rules for single characters with several readings.

前三季度.meaning: the first three quarters of the year (January to September)

新质生产力.meaning: "new quality productive forces": policy term for innovation-driven, high-tech productivity

生猪.meaning: live hogs; pigs raised for slaughter

存栏.meaning: livestock on hand; number of animals currently in stock

出栏.meaning: (of livestock) sent to slaughter or market; slaughter numbers

senses.动能: (economics) momentum; growth driver, as in 新动能 "new growth drivers"

readings.note: In 以…为… (take … as …) the reading is wéi, not wèi.
